From 1 Jan 2022, members who have eligible stand-alone extras cover may claim the cost of a third-party ambulance subscription fee from the Health Program benefit category (sub-limits apply).
Detail: All permanent Queensland residents are covered under the State scheme delivered by Queensland Ambulance Service (QAS), including interstate travel, therefore no additional benefit is payable.
